title: 2023-2024 Retail Sales Performance Report
executive_summary: Analysis of 520 cleaned retail orders reveals total revenue of $445,325.09 for 2023-2024, with a strong 10.1% year-over-year growth. The East region leads regional performance, while 2024 quarterly trends show revenue peaking in Q3. High-discount electronics orders represent a modest portion of sales, and customer concentration risk appears low with the top customer contributing 6.2% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: The dataset contains 520 orders generating a total revenue of $445,325.09, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
Regional revenue performance is led by the East region at $130,516.69, followed by North at $124,845.75, West at $99,428.16, and South at $90,534.49.
In 2024, quarterly revenue increased from $36,108.31 in Q1 to a peak of $71,674.99 in Q3, before settling at $68,948.71 in Q4.
Revenue increased from $211,976.29 in 2023 to $233,348.80 in 2024, representing a 10.1% year-over-year growth.
There were 22 high-discount Electronics orders (discount ≥ 20%), contributing a combined revenue of $50,035.33.
Order revenue distribution shows a mean of $856.39 and median of $313.28, with a standard deviation of $1,295.74. Values range from a minimum of $5.27 to a maximum of $7,844.02.
The business serves 222 unique customers. The top customer generated $27,793.13 in revenue, accounting for 6.2% of total revenue.

limitations: The analysis covers only 2023-2024 data; long-term trends cannot be established.
Profitability analysis was not in scope; high-discount revenue figures do not reflect margin impact.
Data quality is dependent on the preceding cleaning stage validation.
conclusion: The business demonstrates healthy growth with a 10.1% revenue increase in 2024. The East region is the strongest performer, and Q3 2024 showed the highest quarterly revenue. With 222 unique customers and no single customer exceeding 6.3% of revenue, the revenue base appears well-diversified.
